channel.description: Latest articles from Al-Jazeera Media Network (aljazeera.com)

item.title: Activist group Extinction Rebellion says it is under FBI investigation
item.description: Environmental group says FBI is visiting activists' homes as Trump administration rolls back pollution protections.

item.title: N Korea’s Kim unveils 50 rocket launchers ahead of key congress
item.description: Kim hails nuclear-capable weapons as 'wonderful' and 'attractive' as N Korea gears up for a once-in-five-year congress.

item.title: At least 37 killed in Nigeria mine carbon monoxide poisoning: Reports
item.description: Illegal mining is a widespread issue in Nigeria, where operations lack both government oversight and safety protocols.

item.title: Houthi threats and US-Iran conflict escalate Ramadan fears in Yemen
item.description: Yemenis in Sanaa worry as tensions between the Houthis and the US rise, amid memories of last Ramadan's violence.

item.title: ‘Proof of concept’? What Trump can achieve in first Board of Peace meeting
item.description: Analysts say Trump will seek to show Gaza progress at controversial board meet, but pressure on Israel needed for gains.

item.title: Twelve killed in China fireworks shop blast during Lunar New Year
item.description: Five children among the dead as authorities warn of ongoing holiday safety risks.

item.title: Les Wexner says he was conned by Epstein; Democrats push back on testimony
item.description: Tycoon tells legislators that Jeffrey Epstein stole 'vast sums' from him and denies knowledge of the financier's crimes.

item.title: Aid reaches Sudan’s Kordofan as over 30 countries alarmed by drone attacks
item.description: Food trucks arrive in area that has been cut off for two years as spate of deadly drone attacks hampers relief efforts.

item.title: World leaders discuss AI future at India’s global summit in New Delhi
item.description: UN chief Guterres calls for open AI access and warns against leaving its future to the 'whims of a few billionaires'.

item.title: South Korea’s ex-President Yoon Suk Yeol found guilty of insurrection
item.description: South Korean court finds former President Yoon Suk Yeol guilty over declaration of martial law in December 2024.
